Sachin Kumar
--Applicant
 
Versus
State of Uttarakhand
--Respondent
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J. 
Mr. Prince Chauhan, learned counsel for the 
applicant.
2. Mrs. Sweta Badola Dobhal, learned Brief 
Holder, for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. Mr. Sandeep Kothari, learned counsel for the 
complainant/victim.
4. Let the respondents may file objections 
positively within a week specifying the role of each 
of the applicant since it has been reported that in 
total 11 persons have been arrested. A specific 
averment is made in paragraph 5 of the bail 
application that the applicant is nowhere 
concerned in this incident and even as per the 
prosecution he was only standing at the place of 
incident.
5. Let the State may either file the objections or 
to get the instructions, particularly, in reference to 
the averment made in paragraph 5 of the affidavit.
6. Put up this matter on 18.09.2026.
 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 07.09.2026
Nitesh
